guest_bio_html: T.D. (Thomas Dean) Donnelly has made his living as a Hollywood screenwriter for more than thirty years, since his first feature script sold in a three-studio bidding war after he graduated from USC film school. His work includes adapting Clive Cussler's Sahara for the screen. He began writing novels during the Hollywood writers' strike and is the author of the Malcolm Chaucer spy thrillers, starting with Year of the Rabbit. His book Super Draft sets out his creator-versus-critic approach to the writing process.
